verdict.rationale: The pack offers only page titles near this story: Alerts, Issue Status (triage states), Billing Quota Management, "Advanced quota management" on pricing, and Fingerprint Rules for grouping. These suggest Sentry has alert configuration, issue triage states and quota controls that could reduce noise, but none of them describes how. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of spike protection, per-DSN/key rate limits, documented mute/ignore (archive) rule behavior, alert throttling or deduplication details, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
